status: ADOPTED for build v6_build_001 (2026-11-02, user instruction to build and train overnight). Rules below are fixed before any training.
grouping: patient_group = genuine or filename-derived patient id; otherwise a per-image group. Groups are then merged (union-find) with every image they share an exact (md5) or confirmed near-duplicate (pHash + correlation) with, so duplicates can never cross splits.

near_duplicate.note: pairs within the threshold are merged into one split group; development images matching the external cohort are excluded

nih_cxr14.known_limitation: labels are NLP-mined from reports, not image-read

vindr_cxr.label_source: annotations/image_labels_train.csv (3 radiologists per training image) and image_labels_test.csv (consensus)

rules.when: majority of radiologists mark 'Pleural effusion' AND no majority for any of: Nodule/Mass, Lung tumor, Pneumonia, Tuberculosis, Consolidation
rules.label: Pleural Effusion

rules.when: majority mark 'Nodule/Mass' AND no majority for: Pleural effusion, Pneumonia, Tuberculosis, Consolidation
rules.label: Pulmonary Nodule / Mass

vindr_cxr.record: all co-occurring findings are kept in source_label_set
vindr_cxr.known_limitation: no patient identifiers; images are de-identified per study

rules.when: category == active TB only (no latent-TB annotation)
rules.label: Tuberculosis

exclude.reason: cause of abnormality unspecified; not evidence of pneumonia
latent TB is not an active-TB radiographic label

shenzhen.patient_id: one image per subject (per NLM documentation; to confirm)

rules.when: filename suffix _1 (TB manifestation per clinical reading)
rules.label: Tuberculosis

shenzhen.note: Replaces the Rahman TB archive, which aggregates Shenzhen, Montgomery and Belarus images.

rahman_tb.reason: Aggregated archive reported to contain NLM Montgomery images (the external cohort) and renamed files without patient identity. Use the official Shenzhen set instead; reconsider only after check_external_overlap.py proves no overlap.

kermany.patient_id: derived_from_filename (personNNN / IM-NNNN tokens, scoped by original folder)
kermany.known_limitation: age and acquisition differ from all adult sources; the class may be learnable from age alone. Report per-source metrics.

covid_radiography.include: DECISION REQUIRED (default true, COVID class only)
covid_radiography.record: upstream source URL from the archive metadata in source_label_raw
covid_radiography.known_limitation: single-source class; aggregated from web collections; multiple images per patient possible. A patient-identified alternative (BIMCV-COVID19+) requires a separate access request.

jsrt.note: V5 excluded benign nodules because the class was once 'Lung Cancer'. For a radiological Nodule/Mass class, benign nodules are valid positives.

montgomery.role: external evaluation only (binary normal vs TB)

cohen_covid.patient_id: genuine (metadata.csv patientid, assigned by the collection)

rules.when: modality X-ray, frontal view (PA/AP*), finding contains 'COVID-19'
rules.label: COVID-19

rules.when: frontal X-ray, finding starts with 'Pneumonia' and does not contain COVID-19
rules.label: Pneumonia

cohen_covid.exclude: lateral views, CT, other findings, images outside the images/ folder
cohen_covid.known_limitation: images collected from publications and websites (often cropped/annotated); heterogeneous acquisition

sampling.note: Caps are applied per (source, class) by sampling whole patient groups with the seed below, BEFORE splitting and training. They bound CPU training time and limit any single source dominating a class.
